title: Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury
abstract: arXiv:2610.11155v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-suicidal self-injury (NSSI) is prevalent among adolescents with depression, but the rapid brain-state dynamics linking social distress to maladaptive behavior remain unclear. We combine an experimental pain paradigm, electroencephalography (EEG) microstate analysis, and interpretable deep sequence modeling to investigate NSSI-related neurodynamics in 106 adolescents with depression, including 67 with NSSI (DN+) and 39 without NSSI (DN-), during social pain, physical pain, and resting-state conditions. A model integrating disease-specific, domain-adversarial, consistency, and contrastive learning captures higher-order dependencies in microstate sequences. Social pain yields the strongest NSSI discrimination, with 68.55% accuracy, outperforming the best baseline by 8.94% points. Model interpretation and conventional microstate analyses reveal weakened bidirectional transitions between MS3 and MS5 in DN+ adolescents during social pain.

translated_title: 社交痛苦破坏非自杀性自伤青少年的情绪-动作脑状态动力学
translated_abstract: 非自杀性自伤（NSSI）在青少年抑郁患者中普遍存在，但将社交困扰与不良行为联系起来的快速脑状态动力学仍不清楚。我们结合实验性疼痛范式、脑电图（EEG）微状态分析和可解释的深度序列建模，研究了106名抑郁青少年（其中67名有NSSI（DN+），39名无NSSI（DN-））在社交痛苦、躯体疼痛和静息态条件下的NSSI相关神经动力学。一个整合了疾病特异性、域对抗、一致性和对比度学习的模型捕捉了微状态序列中的高阶依赖关系。社交痛苦产生了最强的NSSI判别力，准确率达68.55%，比最佳基线高出8.94个百分点。模型解释和传统微状态分析均显示，DN+青少年在社交痛苦期间MS3与MS5之间的双向转换减弱。
tldr: 该研究结合EEG微状态分析与可解释深度序列模型，发现社交痛苦条件下非自杀性自伤青少年MS3与MS5脑微状态间的双向转换减弱，据此实现了对NSSI的高精度判别（准确率68.55%，优于最佳基线8.94个百分点）。
en_tdlr: Combining EEG microstate analysis with interpretable deep sequence modeling, this study reveals weakened bidirectional transitions between microstates MS3 and MS5 in adolescents with non-suicidal self-injury during social pain, enabling 68.55% accurate NSSI discrimination.
